priority_reason: Existing playable consumer hardcodes twelve gameplay actions; reversible remapping gives players actual control without changing commitment or expanding unrelated labs.
runtime: Godot4.6.3.stable.official.7d41c59c4 standard; Python3.12; Linux x86_64; Xorg dummy/OpenGL Mesa25.0.7 llvmpipe LLVM19.1.7; Dummy audio
scope: Twelve keyboard actions in the actual native crossing/rehearsal, cancellable settings, matching hints and separate recoverable device-local preferences. No new combat rules, classes, account state or accessibility certification.

chapters.ENG-022: Human factors, predictable recovery and cognitive load.
chapters.SCI-061: Actual task/device usability controls and representative-human validity limits.
chapters.CRE-075: Contextual HUD/readability hypothesis; hints follow applied bindings.
chapters.CRE-081: Documented remapping/accessibility direction, not independent accessibility validation.

brain_activation.method: Read all three indices, searched accessibility, retrieved complete pertinent chapters before improvements; consulted existing combat-response/character-keepsake findings. Sources and pins unchanged.

alternatives: New encounter fork: valuable but no specific new fork outranks the inspected fixed-input gap after medicine recovery.
Audiovisual threat identity: potential value; no diagnosed fault or physical perceptual validation setup this cycle.
Selected reversible keyboard remapping in the actual consumer, preserving all character mechanics.
Hold/toggle modes: deferred because commitment semantics require separate design and evaluation.
Standalone origin extraction/research: lower priority than an existing-consumer barrier.

before_after.baseline: Hardcoded gameplay keys; no preference workflow or persistence.
before_after.final: All twelve gameplay bindings drive input and hints; draft/apply/discard/default recovery; new process retains explicit map; invalid/write/replace failures preserve prior bytes and permit repair/retry.
before_after.continuity: Eight existing keepsake plus eight control apply/read/restore/read fresh processes, source/PCK observations identical.

keyboard_protocol: Start actual native title, F1, select interaction, capture conflicting K; keep draft active and name conflict.
Cancel capture, assign F, S apply; reopen and assign H to guard/feint. Saved status and live hint show actual keys.
Start Guardian rehearsal and hold Right/H; actual frontal block passes.
Start a fresh process with preserved controls and the included prepared medicine fixture; Return resumes. Old E cannot recover, held F does.
Open settings, replace only the isolated fixture controls profile with malformed bytes; S preserves them and reports blocked. Remove fixture file, retry S; profile saved.
Synthetic XTest input into Xorg, bounded owned Godot/Xorg processes reaped. Fixture positions are explicit, not full-route navigation or a participant.
presentation: Inspected applied and save-blocked native screenshots: readable selection, draft/active identity, explicit recovery status and matching applied hints. This is implementing-agent assessment, not independent human feedback.
failures_and_refinements: Initial seven persistence controls failed: Dictionary.keys field/method collision, then float/int JSON identity broke exact readback; bracket lookup plus strict integer normalization corrected both.
Actual X11 Down carried differing physical/logical codes, leaving row0 despite synthetic same-code checks. Use logical arrow navigation; added dedicated regression with differing physical code.
Initial repository/source checks ran before RUN existed and reported missing links/cascading reference errors; final complete record is checked again, without weakened gates.
Dummy software driver reports unsupported V-Sync, but rendering/input/capture complete. No performance or physical display/audio claim.

continuity.north_star: Existing local_prototype gains actual recoverable player keyboard control; one consumer/six paths,14 capabilities,only NS-C03 adapted. NS-C13 not promoted.
continuity.knowledge: Existing combat-response finding extended with adapter/device identity and persistence evidence limits. No new lab.
continuity.portfolio: Actual native user-control/recovery demonstration alongside preserved origins and earlier medicine evidence.
continuity.origin_migration: P01-P05/P07/P08/P10/P11 preserved_pending_extraction; P06 pilot_instrumented; P09 seed_only. Source/media/distributions/tests unchanged.
continuity.prompt: Unchanged; present guidance served consumer selection, selective brain activation and actual device-input validation.

limitations: No gamepad/mouse/modifier combinations, hold/toggle mode or remappable fixed management keys. Physical letters/logical arrows are intentional; one Linux software keyboard/display setup tested.
Native/synthetic execution and agent inspection do not establish representative usability, disability outcomes, enjoyment, comprehension or accessibility certification.
Prepared medicine positions do not establish full-route OS-key navigation; complete routes remain deterministic model policies.
Editable device-local preference data, no account/sync/concurrent-writer/power-loss durability/security contract. Invalid profile repair/removal is external and explicit.
No multiplayer/MMORPG scale, commercial claim, new origin integration or final production engine decision.
repository_validation: 100 Python regressions passed (17 brain,27 repository,42 references,11 manifest,3 wrapper). Brain/source/reference/link gates passed; exact manifest check follows final content. Publication/CI separate.
